evidence.excerpt: Many research-agent benchmarks emphasize standalone tasks and relatively self-contained workflows in clean or curated workspaces.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: ARE-bench includes 75 tasks built on agent sessions and full workspaces from recruited researchers' own projects, spanning seven research stages, 33 requirements, and 150 sub-requirements, with 1,173 binary checklist items in total.
